goal: Let the IDE demo show the storage DDL for the selected DBMS pack.
authorship: Hand-authored. Three defects were planted. Four more were added to `expected` after a real run surfaced them; each was verified against the base commit with the commands in evals/README.md before being added.

require: no ddl|does not (emit|produce|exist)|no sql ddl|not exist|false premise|never (emitted|produced)|doesn't exist|absent|pure ddl artifact
expected.notes: The plan's premise - that the compiler already produces DDL reflecting the chosen pack - is false. Only 'file' and 'tree' artifact types exist (IArtifactContributor.cs:29,69); nothing emits SQL DDL, and the repo's own gap map says so.
Adding the MAUI demo head to the only solution file makes a bare `dotnet restore` (and CI's restore step on ubuntu-latest) resolve a net10.0-iOS project with no MAUI workload installed.
Under central package management a Version attribute on PackageReference is an error (NU1008); versions live only in Directory.Packages.props, and the FluentUI reference already exists without one.
The repo runs tests with `dotnet run --project Poly.Tests/Poly.Tests.csproj`, not `dotnet test`.
Poly.Demo.Shared has no Components/ directory and _Imports.razor imports only Poly.Demo.Shared.Layout, so a component at Components/StorageDdlPanel.razor would not resolve from Ide.razor.

Storage packs only take effect in CompileMode.Db or All (DslCompiler.cs SeedFor/LinkedVendor), but the IDE defaults to CompileMode.Entities, so the plan's verification step cannot pass in the default mode.
